RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 15

An all-female panel isn't evidence of bias. Clinical laboratory staff and managers are mostly women in many countries, so such panels are common. Head-of-lab roles are often filled based on management and leadership experience rather than research credentials, so a PhD may not have counted for much. You also don't yet know how either of you scored.

Instead, follow up on your request for a written explanation, citing the date you sent it. Ask for the selection criteria, how they were weighted, and your scores. If the explanation shows inconsistent criteria or comments about sex, that would be real evidence. At that point, consult a union representative or employment lawyer about time limits for a discrimination claim.
